column1: To evaluate generative AI’s capabilities in detecting sentiments on a broader scale, we
will utilize the ChatGPT 4 API. For details on API usage, see chapter 1. It’s also import-
ant to note that accessing the API might require a subscription or a specific pricing
plan. Your goal here is to have ChatGPT assess the sentiment of the first 500 non-
empty reviews from the dataset, and compare these results with those from a basic sen-
timent analysis using keywords, as conducted in section 5.5.4 (listing 5.6).
